signatures.description: Uses Windows utilities for basic Windows functionality

T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">Dear Sir/Ma,
text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">I was researching your company online and got to know about your participation in an exhibition.

HANDU is a Korean company that has worked in the Asian market for over 50 years. We are an International commodity development, advisory and investment business in Seoul, Korea. We own supply directly and also handle import/export brokerage.
We have a client that is requesting us for one of your products. Attached is the products we need as seen on your website.
Please send us your best offer as soon as possible so we can prepare a purchase for the order.
Any questions or clarification please contact us.
